d: Sheikh Hasina wants to return to Bangladesh on December 16, the country's Victory Day, more than two years after fleeing to India. But Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's government has warned that the ousted leader will be arrested if she steps back into the country. With Hasina sentenced to death in absentia over the 2024 crackdown, her proposed homecoming could trigger a fresh political crisis, street violence or a diplomatic confrontation between India and Bangladesh. Will Dhaka arrest her, will her supporters take to the streets, or could New Delhi and Dhaka find a compromise? Hem Kaur…
